kept.title: Planned road and sidewalk work nearby in 2027-2028
kept.detail: Road resurfacing on Kensington Ave, 230 m from the point, is planned for Q2 2027 - Q4 2028. It includes sidewalk and curb repairs and may close lanes or the whole road. New sidewalk is also planned on Wales Ave, 336 m away. The data does not show work on Dundas St West or Spadina Ave at the stops.

cites.quote: KENSINGTON AVE (TO); From: ST ANDREW ST; To: BALDWIN ST | status: Active | timeline: Q2 2027 - Q4 2028 | 230 m from the point
including repairs of any damaged sidewalks and curbs. Work may include the closure of individual lanes or the entire road.

kept.title: Sidewalk clearing starts at 2 cm of snow and can take about 12 hours
kept.detail: City crews start clearing sidewalks once snow reaches 2 cm. A full clearing cycle takes about 12 hours. Snow under 2 cm, or snow during that window, may still be on the walk to the stops.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.

kept.title: Public laneways are salted, not plowed
kept.detail: The City's level of service for public laneways is salting within 24 hours after snowfall ends, with no plowing. Any walking route that uses a laneway may still have snow on it.

cites.quote: The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall
snow plowing is not provided.

kept.title: Unclear whether these stops get priority winter clearing
kept.detail: The report says the TTC gave a list of priority stops and routes to focus clearing efforts. The data does not show whether the stops at Dundas and Spadina are on that list.

cites.quote: the TTC provided a list of priority stops and routes, which helped focus clearing efforts on high- traffic and higher-risk locations.
